tagline: Clinical-stage oncology company developing Alpha DaRT technology for localized radiation therapy of solid tumors
hero_kpi_rationale: Clinical-stage biotech company with growing R&D investments ($32.1M USD in 2025), reflecting acceleration in clinical development and Alpha DaRT trials

kpis.name: R&D Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total annual spending on research and development activities including clinical trials.
kpis.description: R&D expenses increased by $5.0M USD (18.7% YoY) in 2025, primarily driven by increases in salaries, raw material costs, and outsourced clinical trial expenses.
kpis.signal: Acceleration of R&D investment in advanced clinical stage

kpis.name: Operating Loss
kpis.explanation: Total operating expenses minus revenues for the period.
kpis.description: Total operating loss increased to $42.3M USD in 2025 compared to $36.0M USD in 2024, reflecting acceleration in clinical and administrative expenses.
kpis.signal: Increase in operating losses in pre-commercial stage

kpis.name: Net Loss
kpis.explanation: Total net loss after all expenses and income items.
kpis.description: Net loss increased by $10.9M USD (34.3% YoY) to $42.6M USD in 2025, primarily due to increased operating loss and decreased net financial income.
kpis.signal: Deterioration in net loss related to financial items and clinical expansion

kpis.name: Cash and Equivalents
kpis.explanation: Total liquid cash available to the company.
kpis.description: Cash was $12.2M USD in 2025, down $1.5M USD due to operational cash consumption, partially offset by $45.8M USD in financing in 2025.
kpis.signal: Reduced cash position following capital increase in April 2025

kpis.name: Total Liquid Resources
kpis.explanation: Total liquid resources including cash, short-term deposits and restricted deposits.
kpis.description: Total liquid resources (cash, short-term deposits and restricted deposits) amounted to $76.9M USD in 2025, an increase of $14.0M USD from $62.9M USD in 2024.
kpis.signal: Strengthened liquidity position from capital increases in 2025

kpis.name: Operating Cash Burn
kpis.explanation: Cash consumed by operating activities, representing the burn rate.
kpis.description: Operating cash burn increased to $26.7M USD in 2025 compared to $19.8M USD in 2024, reflecting increased operating losses and investments in clinical trials.
kpis.signal: Acceleration in cash burn related to clinical expansion

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on property, equipment and infrastructure.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures increased to approximately $3.8M USD in 2025, related to acquisitions of property and equipment for production capacity and clinical facilities.
kpis.signal: Moderate CAPEX for a clinical-stage biotech

kpis.name: Gross Proceeds Raised (Cumulative)
kpis.explanation: Total cumulative gross proceeds from equity financing since inception.
kpis.description: Cumulative gross proceeds of $225.3M USD raised since inception, supplemented by $8.8M USD in government grants to fund Alpha DaRT development and clinical trials.

risks.title: Absence of revenues and chronic operating losses
risks.score_rationale: Major risk at the forefront of Item 1A (dominant position). Intense language: « significant losses since inception », « accumulated deficit of $190,136 ». Trend stable/increasing (losses expected « over the foreseeable future »). Critical weight for pre-commercialization biotech.

risks.title: Critical dependence on radioisotope supply
risks.score_rationale: Business-specific risk explicitly cited (« unable to obtain a sufficient or sufficiently pure supply »). Medium-high intensity language. Trend stable (structural technology risk). Critical category for manufacturing viability.

risks.title: Novel technological approach with unpredictable risks
risks.score_rationale: Fundamental business risk: « novel approach to radiation therapy creates significant and potentially unpredictable challenges ». High uncertainty language. Trend stable (inherent to model). High weight for pre-approval technology.

risks.title: Clinical acceptance and market for radiation therapies
risks.score_rationale: Explicit commercial risk: « commercial success depends on public perception of radiation therapies ». Moderate language. Trend stable (structural market risk). Medium weight for pre-commercialization stage.

risks.title: Absence of commercial and marketing capabilities
risks.score_rationale: Explicit business risk: « no experience in marketing our products » and « unable to establish marketing and sales capabilities ». Direct language. Trend stable (structural pre-commercialization risk). High weight for commercial viability.

risks.title: Regulatory risks and international marketing approvals
risks.score_rationale: Critical risk repeated: « extensive government regulation », « may not receive necessary marketing authorizations », « failure to timely obtain ». Very high intensity language. Trend stable (structural risk). Critical weight for commercial viability.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection and counterfeiting risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicit IP risk: « unable to obtain and maintain patent protection » and « competitors could develop similar products ». Medium-high intensity language. Trend stable (structural biotech risk). High weight for competitive defense.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks related to Israeli operations
risks.score_rationale: Explicit geopolitical risk: « Conditions in Israel could materially and adversely affect our business ». Moderate but direct language. Trend stable (structural localization risk). Medium weight for Israel-based company.

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of artificial intelligence in provided documents. Technology relies on nuclear physics and targeted radiotherapy with alpha emitters (Alpha DaRT), not on AI or machine learning.
evidence: Technology based on specific biological properties of alpha particles and diffusion of alpha emitters (DaRT)
Funding and development centered on clinical trials and radiotherapy optimization
No reference to software, AI or machine learning in 10-K/20-F filings
